root_cause.cause: Each worker correctly constructed and validated an AdaptiveDevelopmentObservation, then returned model_dump(mode='json'). JSON mode represents tuple-valued positions as lists. The parent called strict model_validate on that Python dictionary, where strict tuple fields reject lists. The same payload is valid through model_validate_json because JSON has no tuple primitive and Pydantic applies the declared tuple target while retaining strict field validation.

Consequently all 144 paired serial tasks finished even though progress.log remained empty.
